title: Cape Breton Oatcakes
ingredients: 8 Tbsp. (1 stick / 113g) Unsalted Butter (melted and hot)
1 1/4 tsp. Fine Sea Salt (or Kosher salt)
instructions:
1. The Coarse Pulse: Add 1 1/4 cups flour, 1/3 cup brown sugar, 1/4 cup white sugar, salt, and baking powder to food processor. Run for 10 seconds to eliminate lumps. Add 1 1/4 cups rolled oats. Pulse exactly 4 times to coarsely crack flakes without turning into flour.

2. Wet Bind & Knead: Pour 8 tablespoons hot melted butter and 2 tablespoons boiling water directly over dry mixture. Pulse 6 times until dough resembles wet sand. Turn out onto clean surface and press firmly into a cohesive, warm disc.

3. Template & Roll Ultra-Thin: Draw a 10x12-inch rectangle on parchment paper. Flip pencil-side down. Place dough in center, cover with second parchment sheet, and roll firmly to fill template completely (guaranteeing exact 1/8-inch thickness).

4. Flash Freeze & Slice: Peel off top parchment. Trim edges cleanly to match template lines. Slide dough on paper onto a tray and freeze for 15 minutes until solid. Slice cleanly into an 8x5 grid to create 40 small rectangles.

5. Airflow Spacing & Hot Bake: Preheat oven to 300°F (150°C) with Convection (or 325°F / 160°C Standard). Distribute 40 pieces evenly across 4 small black single-layer aluminum pans, leaving a 1-inch empty channel down center of each pan. Bake for 32 to 36 minutes until uniformly deep-golden, rotating pans front-to-back halfway through.

6. Residual Heat Setup: Let sit on hot pans undisturbed for 10 minutes to finish crisping. Transfer to wire rack for 20 minutes until completely cold and snap-brittle.

title: Grilled Kofta-Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. vegetable oil, plus more for grill
3 1/2 tsp. Diamond Crystal or 2 1/4 tsp. Morton kosher salt, divided, plus more
1/2 cup finely chopped salted toasted pistachios, plus more coarsely chopped for serving
1/2 tsp. freshly ground pepper, plus more
4 large bell peppers, halved lengthwise, ribs and seeds removed
1 cup plain whole-milk Greek yogurt or labneh
instructions:
1. Prepare Couscous Base: Prepare a grill for medium heat; oil grate. Combine couscous, baharat, and 1 1/2 tsp. Diamond Crystal or 1 tsp. Morton kosher salt in a large heatproof bowl. Pour in 1/2 cup plus 2 tsp. boiling water. Cover bowl with a kitchen towel; let sit 5 minutes.

2. Mix Meat & Fillings: Using a fork, break up couscous. Add shallot, garlic, ground beef, cilantro, 1/2 cup finely chopped pistachios, 1 1/2 tsp. salt, and 1/2 tsp. black pepper. Gently mix and set aside.

3. Pre-Char Peppers: Drizzle halved bell peppers with 1 Tbsp. oil, salt, and pepper. Grill cut side down until just starting to char (about 3 mins). Let cool skin side down.

4. Stuff & Grill: Lightly fill each bell pepper half with 1/2 cup meat mixture. Grill skin side down covered for about 20 minutes until filling registers 165°F.

5. Serve: Whisk yogurt, lemon zest, lemon juice, and remaining 1/2 tsp. salt. Top peppers with pistachios and serve with lemon yogurt.

title: Lemon Bar Cookie Cups
ingredients: 4 Eggs, divided (2 whole eggs + 2 egg yolks)
instructions:
Preheat oven to 375°F. Line or lightly spray a muffin tin.

In a small bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients (flour, baking soda, and baking powder).

In a large mixing bowl, cream together softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract. Gradually add dry ingredients to wet mixture, mixing until a dough forms.

Form dough into 1-inch balls and place one ball into each muffin cup. Bake for 8-10 minutes until lightly golden. Immediately upon removing from the oven, gently press down the center of each cookie with the back of a spoon to form a cup shape. Let cool completely in the pan.

Prepare Lemon Curd: In a saucepan, cream softened butter and sugar. Whisk in 2 whole eggs, 2 egg yolks, and lemon juice. Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly until the mixture thickens (about 5 minutes). Remove from heat and let cool slightly.

Spoon warm lemon curd into the cooled cookie cups. Top with freshly grated lemon zest and chill in the refrigerator until set.

Gently remove cookie cups from tin and dust generously with powdered sugar before serving.

title: Rhubarb Custard Pie
instructions:
MIX SUGAR AND CORN STARCH TOGETHER. ADD TO CUT UP RHUBARB. COOK UNTIL CREAMY. ADD BEATEN EGG YOKES. COOL. POUR INTO A BAKED PIE SHELL.

MERINGE: 3 EGG WHITES, 3 TBSP. WATER. BEAT EGG WHITES AND WATER UNTIL THEY FORM STIFF PEAKS. ADD ABOUT 3 TBSP. SUGAR. COVER PIE. BAKE 425 UNTIL GOLDEN BROWN.
snippet: Rhubarb, Sugar, Corn starch, Egg yokes...

title: Rhubarb Delight
instructions:
Spread chopped rhubarb evenly in a 9x13-inch baking pan. Sprinkle 1 cup white sugar over the rhubarb, followed by the dry strawberry jello powder, then cover evenly with mini marshmallows.

Prepare topping: cream sugar and shortening, beat in egg and milk, then fold in flour, baking powder, and salt. Spoon batter evenly over marshmallow layer.

Bake at 300°F for 50 minutes until golden and bubbling.
snippet: Fresh rhubarb (chopped), White sugar, Strawberry jello, Mini marshmallows, and 7 more ingredients...

title: Rhubarb Sour Cream Pie
instructions:
ARRANGE RHUBARB EVENLY IN UNBAKED PIE SHELL. IN BOWL WHISK TOGETHER EGG, SUGAR, SOUR CREAM AND FLOUR UNTIL SMOOTH. POUR OVER FRUIT.

TOPPING: IN SMALL BOWL MIX TOGETHER FLOUR AND SUGAR. DRIZZLE IN BUTTER AND MIX UNTIL CRUMBLY. SPRINKLE OVER FILLING. BAKE 450 FOR 15 MINS THEN 350 FOR ABOUT 40 MINS.
snippet: Chopped rhubarb, Egg, Granulated sugar, Sour cream, and 4 more ingredients...

title: Rhubarb Walnut Muffins
ingredients: 1/2 cup plus 2 Tbsp. packed Brown Sugar
instructions:
In a bowl, combine brown sugar, melted butter, egg, vanilla, and buttermilk. Stir in diced rhubarb and chopped walnuts.

In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. Gently fold into the wet mixture until just moistened.

Spoon batter into greased muffin tins. Brush tops with 1 Tbsp melted butter and sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar topping.

Bake at 350°-375°F for about 20 minutes.
snippet: Plus 2 tbsp. packed brown sugar, Melted butter, Egg, Vanilla, and 10 more ingredients...

title: Snicker Doodle Coffee Cake
instructions:
Sift together flour, sugar, salt, cinnamon, and baking powder.

Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter; pour into dry ingredients and mix well.

Spread into a greased square baking pan. Sprinkle top generously with cinnamon and sugar.

Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.
snippet: Flour, Sugar, Pinch of salt, Cinnamon, and 5 more ingredients...

title: Spiced Beef
instructions:
Place meat on heavy foil. Wipe surface dry and rub with tenderizer. Take a sharp knife and poke small holes throughout the brisket; insert slices of garlic into the holes.

Mix salt, sugar, dash of cinnamon, saltpetre, and whole mixed spices thoroughly. Rub spices and salt deeply into both sides of the brisket.

Wrap foil tightly around the meat and refrigerate for 6 days, turning daily. Bake at 300°F for about 3 hours until tender.
snippet: Or 8 lbs. point brisket, Salt, Sugar, Dash of cinnamon, and 3 more ingredients...

title: Spicey Bran Muffins
instructions: Combine all bran and milk. Let stand until moisture is taken up. Add egg and shortening; beat well. Stir in raisins. Add flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg. Add to All-bran mixture, stirring only until combined. Bake 400 for 20 -25 mins.

title: Spicy Ranch Chicken
ingredients: 1 Tbsp. hot sauce (such as Frank's RedHot)
2 1/2 tsp. Diamond Crystal or 1 1/2 tsp. Morton kosher salt, divided, plus more
2 lb. thin-sliced skinless, boneless chicken breasts or regular chicken breasts
Coarsely chopped chives and/or dill (for serving; optional)
instructions:
1. Make Dressing: Whisk lemon zest, juice, yogurt, mayonnaise, dried dill, garlic powder, onion powder, hot sauce, pepper, sugar, and 1 tsp. salt in a large bowl. Reserve 1/2 cup for serving.

2. Prep & Marinate: Slice chicken into thin cutlets if using regular breasts. Add to remaining dressing with 1 1/2 tsp. salt and toss to coat. Marinate 30 mins to 12 hours.

3. Grill: Prepare grill for medium-high indirect heat. Grill chicken over direct heat until dark marks appear (~4 mins), flip, and move to indirect heat until cooked through (~3 mins).

4. Serve: Slice crosswise into 3–4 pieces, spoon reserved dressing on platter, arrange chicken on top, and scatter fresh herbs.
snippet: Lemon zest and juice, plain whole-milk yogurt, mayonnaise, dried dill, garlic powder, onion powder, and 7 more ingredients...

title: Spinach Squares
instructions: In large bowl beat eggs. Add butter, flour, milk, salt and baking powder. Stir in cheese, cooked onion and spinach. Spoon into 9"x13" greased pan and level. Bake 350° 35 minutes. Cool and cut into bite-sized squares. Freezes well. (Defrost and reheat 15 mins.) Makes 45 pieces.

title: Sweet and Sour Meatballs
instructions:
Shape ground meat and onion seasoned with salt and pepper into meatballs and place in a baking dish.

In a bowl, whisk together ketchup, dry mustard, vinegar, water, flour, and brown sugar until smooth to make the sweet and sour sauce.

Pour sauce generously over meatballs. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 1 hour.
snippet: Ground meat, Onion (finely chopped), Salt and pepper to taste, Ketchup, and 5 more ingredients...

title: Tea Biscuits
instructions:
Preheat oven to 425F.
Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in shortening finely with a pastry blender or two knives.
Add milk and stir with a fork to make a soft dough.
Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead gently 8 to 10 times.
Roll or pat to desired thickness.
Cut with a floured 1 3/4-inch cookie cutter.
Place biscuits on an ungreased baking sheet, close together for soft-sided biscuits or about 1 inch apart for crusty-sided biscuits.
Bake in preheated 425F oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
Makes 20 biscuits.
snippet: 2 cups all purpose flour, 4 teaspoons baking powder, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 cup shortening, and 1 more ingredient...
